 News › News News › HSC, SSC Time Table 2027 Maharashtra Board Out Soon @mahahsscboard.in; Check latest updates HSC, SSC Time Table 2027 Maharashtra Board Out Soon @mahahsscboard.in; Check latest updates
 Jasleen Taneja Updated: Oct 26, 2026, 15:55 IST Maharashtra Board time table 2027 out soon The Maharashtra State Board of Secondary and Higher Secondary Education (MSBSHSE) will release the Maharashtra HSC and SSC time table 2027 soon. Students preparing for the upcoming Class 10 and Class 12 board exams Maharashtra state will be able to check the MSBSHSE timetable 2027 class 10 and 12 online.
 According to sources, the authorities are in the final stage of preparing the SSC, HSC time table 2027, and the complete schedule will be out anytime soon. The Maharashtra Board official timetable 2027 is expected to be available online by the end of October 2026.
 When is Maharashtra Board Time Table 2027 expected?
 The state board will upload the official PDF for class 10 and 12 board exams during the evening hours, tentatively after 5:00 pm anytime during this week. The exams for both Secondary School Certificate (SSC) and Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) classes will take place across various designated centres in Maharashtra. 
 Maharashtra HSC exam 2027 will likely be conducted from Feb 8 to Mar 16, while the Maharashtra SSC 2027 exam are expected to be held between Feb 15 and Mar 11, 2027.
 Steps to download Maharashtra HSC SSC Time Table 2027 
 The process to download Maharashtra HSC SSC time table is given below.
 Visit board’s website: mahahsscboard.in
 Click on the Maharashtra HSC SSC Time Table 2027 link
 The timetable appears on screen
 Download and save it
